rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who rides a skateboard.

example.english: The skateboarder at the park is teaching children how to skateboard.
example.traditional: 嗰個玩滑板嘅人喺公園度教細路學滑板。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 waan2 waat6 baan2 ge3 jan4 hai2 gung1 jyun2 dou6 gaau3 sai3 lou6 hok6 waat6 baan2

rows.note: Use this concise noun especially when referring to a skateboarder as an athlete or participant in the sport.

example.english: The skateboarder represented Hong Kong in the competition and performed brilliantly.
example.traditional: 嗰位滑板手代表香港出賽，表現好出色。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 waat6 baan2 sau2 doi6 biu2 hoeng1 gong2 ceot1 coi3 biu2 jin6 hou2 ceot1 sik1
